title: namako pi musi Manka
description: A dedicated minecraft experience made for Toki Pona speakers.
body:
### What is this modpack?
The namako pi musi Manka modpack is a modpack desgined and taylored for Toki Pona speakers. It features QOL mods, preformance mods, visual upgrades, and resourcepacks. Everything included is client-side. (Any issues that exist beyond singleplayer or the musi manka minecraft server will not be resolved.)

### How can I give feedback?
This modpack no longer is recieving updates, however an inspired modpack with Toki Pona support is in the making (for 26.1.2). You can find the link to the discord [here](https://discord.gg/4KTr8phxz9).
  
Other than that, have fun and learn toki pona! o musi pona! o sona e toki pona!
(Oh, and there isn't anything I can do for pictures beyond showing the sitelen pona writing system in minecraft so I took pictures of the kulupu pona server to showcase the minecrafter part of the Toki Pona community)
